label: TP
reason: User-supplied cookie value flows directly into fileTarget via URL decoding, then passed unchanged to File constructor which constructs a path without validation. The ESAPI encoder only escapes HTML output in the response string, not the actual file system path used for access. This enables path traversal attacks (e.g., ../etc/passwd) leading to arbitrary file read/write vulnerabilities.

evidence.note: Cookie value decoded and used directly in File path construction without validation, enabling path traversal
